entries.name: Animal Handling
entries.description: Care and use of animals, including raising, tending, grooming, and healing them. Specialties: falconry, specific animals.

entries.name: Area Lore: {region}
entries.description: Knowledge of one particular region, covenant, or even a village, including where things are in the immediate area, local history and legends, and the centers of power in the region. The smaller the region, the more detailed your knowledge. Specialties: geography, history, legends, politics, personalities.

entries.name: Athletics
entries.description: General physical prowess: moving smoothly, confidently, and with grace, and most large-muscle coordination. Specialties: acrobatics, contortions, grace, jumping, running.

entries.name: Awareness
entries.description: Noticing things, whether sought or unexpected, and staying alert in circumstances that require watchfulness. Specialties: bodyguarding, keeping watch, alertness, searching.

entries.name: Bargain
entries.description: Getting the greatest return for a service or product while paying the least, by reading the person you haggle with, knowing the general value of goods, and presenting yourself well. Specialties: specific types of products, hard sell.

entries.name: Brawl
entries.description: Fighting hand-to-hand without weapons, or with improvised weapons such as knives; also the Ability used to dodge attacks if you have no Martial Abilities. Specialties: punches, grapples, knives, dodging.

entries.name: Carouse
entries.description: Enjoying yourself without suffering adverse effects, such as drinking heavily without passing out, while staying familiar with acceptable behavior and balancing enjoyment with moderation. Lets a character have fun and make friends among the lower classes nearly anywhere, even among a different culture. Specialties: power drinking, drinking songs, games of chance, staying sober.

entries.name: Charm
entries.description: Enticing, fascinating, and endearing others to you on a personal basis; can be used to win someone over emotionally, especially romantically. Specialties: courtly love, first impressions, being witty.

entries.name: Chirurgy
entries.description: Middle Ages-style surgery used to help others recover from physical damage, encompassing tending and binding wounds of all varieties and cauterization. Specialties: cauterization, diagnosis, binding wounds, setting bones.

entries.name: Concentration
entries.description: Focusing your mental faculties on one task, particularly for extended periods, or when attempting a feat that demands extra attention or retrying after a failed action. Especially important for magi, since it helps them maintain concentration on spells despite distractions. Specialties: spell concentration, reading, lab work.

entries.name: Craft: {craft}
entries.description: Making things by hand in a specific trade; distinguished by the material worked with, though a Craft Ability can also cover working with several materials in one specific way. May be purchased more than once for different Crafts -- skill in one Craft does not imply skill in others. Specialties: as appropriate to the craft.

entries.name: Etiquette
entries.description: Knowing the social graces and how to behave in different situations; differs from Charm in that Etiquette covers proper behavior rather than charming behavior. Specialties: nobility, court, peasants, faeries, the Church.

entries.name: Folk Ken
entries.description: Understanding the background, personality, and motives of another person at a glance. Often rolled secretly by the storyguide, so the player doesn't know if the guess was correct or even botched. Specialties: peasants, townsfolk, nobles, clergy, magi, the opposite sex.

entries.name: Guile
entries.description: Telling convincing lies and feigning emotion, belief, or frame of mind; also covers disguising yourself and pretending to be something you are not. Often an opposed roll against the victim's Perception + Folk Ken or, for disguise, Perception + Awareness; understanding the target first grants a bonus. Specialties: particular sorts of deception, lying to authority, fast talk, elaborate lies.

entries.name: Hunt
entries.description: Setting snares, choosing appropriate hunting spots, and following and identifying the spoor of creatures of all varieties; also covers covering your tracks or not leaving any. Specialties: tracking, covering tracks, hunting a specific animal.

entries.name: Intrigue
entries.description: Dealing and plotting, including subtle use of power in non-confrontational ways; also covers negotiation, knowledge of formal and informal rules of conduct, and picking up information about those in power. A vital talent for those who frequent court or a Hermetic Tribunal. Specialties: gossip, plotting, rumormongering, alliances.

entries.name: Judaic Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of Jewish cultural practice as opposed to strictly religious detail, including poetry, folklore, and songs; all Jewish characters are versed in Judaic Lore to some degree. Specialties: folklore, music, poetry, songs.

entries.name: Leadership
entries.description: Getting people to obey your orders and follow you; can also be used to inspire fear in others, cowing them into submission. Specialties: intimidation, in combat, inspiration.

entries.name: Legerdemain
entries.description: Sleight of hand and confidence games requiring a delicate touch and hand-eye coordination, including filching from market stalls, cutting purses, picking locks, and the 'magical' trickery used to fleece credulous folk. Someone trying to spot the character's use of this Ability rolls Perception + Awareness (or their own Legerdemain, if any), with a +3 bonus for particularly delicate moves like picking pockets. Specialties: filching, picking pockets, 'magic' tricks.

entries.name: Living Language: {language}
entries.description: Fluency in a particular living language; when two people speak to each other, the lower Ability score determines how well they communicate, and related languages or dialects may carry a penalty at the storyguide's discretion. Characters are illiterate in the language unless they also have a score in Artes Liberales. Also covers artistic composition and storytelling in the language. Specialties: poetry, prose, specific dialects, expansive vocabulary, specific technical vocabulary, slang, storytelling.

entries.name: Music
entries.description: The ability to sing, play musical instruments, and compose new music. Specialties: sing, compose, any one instrument.

entries.name: Mystery Cult Lore: {cult}
entries.description: Knowledge of the legends, history, structure, operation, and goals of a particular Mystery Cult, including its magics, rites, secret passwords, and symbolism -- how to covertly signal membership and assess another's membership. Also covers the cult's ceremonies and, for a Mystagogue, guiding an Initiate through the Initiation Rites. Specialties: personalities, history, politics, one specific Initiation.

entries.name: Organization Lore: {organization}
entries.description: Knowledge of the legends, history, structure, operation, and goals of a specified organization, from as large as the Church to as small as a local craft guild -- the smaller the organization, the more detailed the knowledge. Order of Hermes Lore is particularly important to most magi. Specialties: personalities, history, politics.

entries.name: Profession: {profession}
entries.description: The ability to do a job that doesn't involve making something, such as jongleur, marshal, reeve, sailor, steward, teamster, or washerwoman. Specialties depend on the profession.

entries.name: Ride
entries.description: Riding and controlling a mount, especially under stress. Specialties: battle, speed, tricks.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.description: Sneaking about without being seen or heard, hiding in place, or following people without their noticing (rolled against the target's Perception). Specialties: hide, sneak, shadowing, urban areas, natural areas.

entries.name: Survival
entries.description: Finding food, water, shelter, a direct route, and relative safety in the wilderness, including mundane tasks like building a fire and cooking without implements. Specialties: specific locales.

entries.name: Swim
entries.description: Propelling yourself through water quickly and efficiently. Specialties: long distances, diving, underwater maneuvering.

entries.name: Teaching
entries.description: The ability to teach an Ability to someone else. Specialties: a particular Ability, particular kinds of student.

entries.name: Art of Memory
entries.description: The creation of memory palaces, a mnemonic technique in which you visualize a number of loci where you commit to memory a symbolic representation of a fact to be remembered; you have a number of loci equal to five times your score. To memorize a complex scene, image, or piece of writing you must succeed at a roll of Intelligence + Art of Memory against an Ease Factor set by the length or complexity of the item; on success you remember it in exact detail and may recall it at will, though it may take time to explore a locus. Characters without this Ability may memorize similar items with an Intelligence roll (with 3 extra botch dice) against the same Ease Factors, but must also repeat the roll to recall the memory perfectly, and lack the well-defined loci system. Specialties: an area of knowledge.

entries.name: Artes Liberales
entries.description: The seven liberal arts (the Trivium: grammar, logic, rhetoric; and the Quadrivium: arithmetic, geometry, astronomy, music) that form the basis of medieval higher education; it would be very rare for a character to have a score in any other Academic Ability without at least one point here. Also covers the ability to read and write: for every point in the Ability, the character can read and write one writing system, provided they know a language that normally uses it. Specialties: grammar, logic, rhetoric, arithmetic, geometry, astronomy, music, Ritual magic, Ceremonial magic.

entries.name: Civil and Canon Law
entries.description: Civil Law is the law of the Roman Empire, the basis for most local legal systems and the law appealed to for international relations. Canon Law is the law of the Church, applying in all nations and governing church workings and some other areas such as marriage; clergy are subject only to Canon Law, not customary or Civil Law. This Ability covers knowledge of both. Other religions, particularly Judaism and Islam, have their own separate versions of this Ability. Specialties: laws and customs of a specific area, papal laws.

entries.name: Common Law
entries.description: Knowledge of the laws of England. There is no auctor for this Ability, and it is only taught in England. Specialties: local laws, exchequer laws.

entries.name: Dead Language: {language}
entries.description: Reading and writing a language no longer in common speech, available only to educated characters; the most important example is Latin, the language of formal education, the Church, and the Order of Hermes, with Arabic, Greek, and Hebrew filling similar roles elsewhere. Specialties: academic usage, Church ceremonies, Hermetic usage.

entries.name: Islamic Law
entries.description: The Muslim version of Civil and Canon Law; the major sources are the Qur'an and the Sunna. Specialties: any one of the sources of Islamic Law, particular topics, customs of a particular area.

entries.name: Medicine
entries.description: The formal study of the body and its diseases, based on the theory of the four humors, whose imbalance causes illness (hence practices like bloodletting). Also covers treating poisons and starvation, but not wounds (see Chirurgy). Specialties: anatomy, apothecary, physician.

entries.name: Philosophiae
entries.description: The study of natural philosophy, moral philosophy, and metaphysics, all with Aristotle as the auctor; studied after the Arts but before Law, Theology, or Medicine. Specialties: natural philosophy, moral philosophy, metaphysics, Ritual magic, Ceremonial magic.

entries.name: Rabbinic Law
entries.description: The Jewish version of Civil and Canon Law; the major sources are the Talmud, the Oral Torah, and the Responsa of the Geonim. Specialties: any one of the sources of Rabbinic Law, dietary laws, particular topics, precedents of a given area.

entries.name: Theology: Christian
entries.description: The study of God and his work in the world, with the Bible and Peter the Lombard's Sententiae as the auctores; theological speculation is abstruse, and many theologians face (and sometimes overturn) accusations of heresy. Specialties: biblical knowledge, heresy, history.

entries.name: Theology: Islam
entries.description: The Islamic equivalent of Theology: Christian; the major sources are the Qur'an and the Sunna. Specialties: the Qur'an, debates, history, prophets.

entries.name: Theology: Judaism
entries.description: The Jewish equivalent of Theology: Christian; the major sources are the Torah, the Nevi'im, and the Kutuvim. Specialties: the Torah, creation, history, prophecies.

entries.name: Theology: Zoroastrian
entries.description: The Mazdean counterpart of Theology: Christian: the teaching of Zoroaster and the Avesta, the faith's doctrine, beliefs and rites. The Cradle and the Crescent also calls it Theology: Mazdean; Mobed Lore (here Organization Lore: Mobeds) covers the priesthood itself, not the faith. Specialties: the Avesta, rites, history.

entries.name: Bows
entries.description: Using bows and arrows. Specialties: any one weapon.

entries.name: Great Weapon
entries.description: Fighting with a weapon that requires two hands to use. Specialties: any one weapon.

entries.name: Single Weapon
entries.description: Fighting with a weapon used in one hand, possibly with a shield in the other; includes lances used from horseback. Specialties: any one weapon or shield, covering that weapon with any shield or none, and that shield with any weapon.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon
entries.description: Fighting at range using weapons which are thrown. Specialties: any one weapon.

entries.name: Siege Weapon
entries.description: Working siege engines: aiming and loosing a small engine yourself, or leading the crew of a large one (Lords of Men p. 114). A siege's bombardment rolls Intelligence + Siege Weapon + the engine's Attack. Specialties: ballistae, mangonels, trebuchets.

entries.name: Crossbow
entries.description: Shooting crossbows and arbalests (Lords of Men pp. 138-139). Unlike other weapons, a crossbow used untrained takes no extra botch dice, and Strength doesn't add to its Damage. Specialties: any one weapon.

entries.name: Code of Hermes
entries.description: Judging events according to the Code of Hermes and the Peripheral Code, including memorized precedents and the practical side of enforcing Hermetic law, such as knowing when to push for a vote or how to present an argument. Specialties: Wizards' Marches, apprentices, mundane relations, Tribunal procedures, political intrigue.

entries.name: Dominion Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of the manifestations of the power of the Divine -- miracles rather than politics (unlike Church Lore) and power rather than doctrine (unlike Theology). Specialties: angels, saints, Divine creatures.

entries.name: Enigmatic Wisdom
entries.description: The understanding Criamon magi have of the Enigma; described in the Hermetic Magic chapter. Cannot be learned by non-Criamon characters, even with access to Arcane Abilities.

entries.name: Faerie Lore
entries.description: Familiarity with faerie powers, weaknesses, motivations, and areas. Specialties: faerie forests, faerie mounds, specific types of faeries.

entries.name: Faerie Magic
entries.description: The connection to the power of the Faerie realm possessed by Merinita magi; cannot be learned by other characters, even with access to Arcane Abilities. Described in the Hermetic Magic chapter.

entries.name: Finesse
entries.description: Manipulating your spells and performing special feats with them, such as positioning objects delicately or precisely targeting spells. Specialties: grace, precision, any one Form.

entries.name: Forest Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of one supernatural forest: an Area Lore for it, and also its spirits, places and the genius locus that rules it, what pleases or angers it and whether it is present. Higher scores let you commune with the spirit, sense its gifts in others, find vis and be welcomed by its denizens; a foreign forest needs three points more. Learned only by practice, at a Source Quality equal to the forest's aura. Specialties: a named forest, spirits, vis.

entries.name: Heartbeast
entries.description: The ability shared by all Bjornaer magi to take the form of their heartbeast; cannot be learned by non-Bjornaer characters, even with access to Arcane Abilities. Described in the Hermetic Magic chapter.

entries.name: Infernal Lore
entries.description: Understanding and familiarity with the Infernal and its agents, including demons and undead and their habits and weaknesses, and the power of curses. Specialties: demons, undead, curses.

entries.name: Magic Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of magical creatures, areas, and traditions. Specialties: creatures, magical traditions, regiones.

entries.name: Magic Theory
entries.description: Knowledge of what magic is and how it works, used primarily in the laboratory for inventing spells and enchanting items; distinct from Magic Lore, which covers magical things in general rather than technical Hermetic theory. Anyone can learn it given a teacher or book, but it is of little use to those without The Gift. Specialties: inventing spells, enchanting items, a single Art.

entries.name: Parma Magica
entries.description: The Hermetic ritual of magic resistance: a two-minute ritual that adds five times your Parma Magica score to your Magic Resistance until the next sunrise or sunset, whichever comes first, and can be temporarily suppressed by concentrating. You may also extend protection to one other consenting person per point of Parma Magica by touch, for as long as either can see the other, at a cost of 3 points to your own effective score while protecting others. Only Gifted characters can learn it, and only Hermetic magi actually know it -- the Order enforces 'Join or Die' on anyone else who learns it. Specialties: protection from any specific Form.

entries.name: Penetration
entries.description: Getting your spell through a target's Magic Resistance. Specialties: any one Art.

entries.name: Animal Ken
entries.description: You can communicate with animals as if they were human beings. Treat your score in Animal Ken as your score in a language the animal speaks fluently, and you can use Animal Handling as a substitute for any social Ability affecting humans. Has no effect on the attitude of animals to you, or you to animals, and other people cannot understand your communication with the animals. Specialties: a particular type of animal, a particular type of communication.

entries.name: Corpse Magic
entries.description: Temporarily revives a corpse that has not received burial rites from a Divinely-sanctioned religion and is relatively intact (at minimum a spine, a skull, and more than half its long bones); it takes fifteen minutes of chanting to awaken the dead. The caster generates a Casting Total (Communication + Corpse Magic + Aura modifier + stress die) compared against Ease Factors to determine what the corpse can be made to do, from merely speaking to being animated and placed under direct mental control; commanding an animated corpse uses a Communication + Leadership roll, and the character must know the language the corpse spoke in life. Animated corpses typically have a Magic Might of 9, which the Corpse Magic's Penetration Total must exceed to raise them from the grave. Specialties: kings, soldiers, compelling truth, animating the dead.

entries.name: Crafter's Healing
entries.description: Treats a wound, once per wound regardless of severity, with a Presence + Crafter's Healing roll against the Ease Factor for improving that wound's recovery; success heals the wound one level (heavy to medium, medium to light, light to healed), at a cost of a Long-Term Fatigue level. A failed roll wastes the fatigue for no effect; a botch inflicts a similar wound on the healer. The recipient gains a Warping Point each time this Ability is used on them, win or lose. Specialties: particular kinds of wounds.

entries.name: Curse-Throwing
entries.description: Heals diseases, removes curses, and dispels detrimental magical effects by transferring their effects to another person via an elaborate ritual -- a charm combining a physical object and a repeated chant, touched to both target and recipient (or an Arcane Connection to the recipient). Cannot affect Flaws such as Lesser or Greater Malediction, but can transfer other curses, diseases, or harmful magical effects; if either party has Magic Resistance, the caster's Penetration Total must exceed it. A botch swaps the curse onto the caster instead. Specialties: diseases, faerie curses, livestock.

entries.name: Dowsing
entries.description: Finding things nearby using a dowsing rod and intuitive sense: concentrate on the thing sought, hold the rod out, and follow its motions to the target. Finding something specific requires an appropriate sympathetic connection to it. The searcher must designate the search area in advance -- if the item isn't present, the attempt automatically fails -- and the time required depends on the size of the area. Specialties: searching for a particular kind of thing, searching in a particular kind of place.

entries.name: Embitterment
entries.description: Causes one person to hate another; described in the Hermetic Magic chapter.

entries.name: Enchanting: {performance}
entries.description: Influencing others through a particular performance Ability. A specific effect requires words the audience can understand; general effects work on animals, but specific effects only work on creatures that understand words. Roll Communication + Enchanting Ability against an Ease Factor set by the desired effect -- calming, winning love, inciting a riot, or greater feats -- and Penetrate Magic Resistance if the target has any. A botched roll produces an unwanted emotion instead. Specialties: a particular emotion, a particular sort of person.

entries.name: Entrancement
entries.description: Controls another's will: by holding eye contact for several seconds and speaking a verbal command, roll Presence + Entrancement against the target's Stamina, with a possible bonus for the victim depending on how dangerous or objectionable the command is. Hermetic magi resist with their normal Mentem Magic Resistance. The blind and those with closed eyes are immune, and a victim cannot look away unless they win the opposed roll. Specialties: a specific sort of command, a specific sort of person.

entries.name: Font of Knowledge
entries.description: Lets a creature attempt a task with any untrained Ability as if it possessed a score of 2, by succeeding at an Intelligence + Font of Knowledge roll against an Ease Factor that rises with repeated use in a day (failed attempts still count toward the daily total). Specialties: a particular topic.

entries.name: Hex
entries.description: Brings injury or ruin on an enemy: activated by making eye contact and declaring your purpose aloud, by tracing occult signs and symbols on the target, or via an Arcane Connection and a representation that channels the effect through sympathetic magic, always with a physical component such as tying knots or the evil eye. The caster states a time frame for the effect (from immediate to generational -- sooner manifestations are weaker, longer delays more potent) and rolls Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + delay modifier against an Ease Factor to determine severity, from a minor mishap up to sudden death. A botch may misfire onto the caster or someone close to her instead. Victims can undo a hex through Divine absolution or other supernatural remedies. Specialties: a specific duration, one method of hexing, a particular effect.

entries.name: Induction
entries.description: Creates illusions visible only to the target's mind; each attempt requires talking to the victim for at least a minute, and characters who cannot hear the inducer are immune. Roll Communication + Induction against an Ease Factor set by how risky the illusion is to believe, not its complexity -- the victim remains dimly aware of reality and can snap out of it if threatened. A successful inducer can spend more time to escalate the risk level further. Specialties: particular kinds of illusion.

entries.name: Magic Sensitivity
entries.description: Lets you identify a place or object as magical, at the cost of subtracting your Magic Sensitivity score from your own Magic Resistance. Roll Perception + Magic Sensitivity against an Ease Factor the storyguide sets based on what's being detected -- an aura, an active spell or enchanted item, or a magical creature's Might. Specialties: auras, magical creatures, enchanted items, active spells.

entries.name: Persona
entries.description: Lets you alter your appearance to adopt a different identity -- hair and eye color, complexion, build, height within your Size, apparent age, even gender -- total changes proof against even intimate scrutiny, though your Characteristics, Virtues, and Flaws remain unchanged. Adopting or shedding an identity takes a round of concentration and a Stamina + Persona roll against an Ease Factor of 9. You gain one identity per point of Persona, and must design a new one each time the Ability increases. Specialties: priests, peasants, magi.

entries.name: Premonitions
entries.description: An intuitive sense that something is wrong or likely to go wrong soon; roll Perception + Premonitions against an Ease Factor set by the imminence and severity of the danger. Beating the Ease Factor by 3 or more also grants some sense of the danger's nature, with more detail the higher the roll. Specialties: threats to a particular person or group of people, particular kinds of threats.

entries.name: Second Sight
entries.description: Lets you see through illusionary concealment and disguise, including invisibility, and see naturally invisible things such as spirits and the boundaries between regio levels. The Ease Factor to see through concealment is usually 6 plus the magnitude of the effect or the responsible creature's Might; seeing a naturally invisible thing is usually Ease Factor 9. Does not let you see a creature's or spell's true underlying form if it has actually been transformed. Specialties: regiones, invisible things, illusory disguises, faeries, ghosts.

entries.name: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
entries.description: Lets you feel the presence of good and evil: a Perception + Sense Holiness and Unholiness roll against an Ease Factor of 9 senses holiness or unholiness in a general area, or 15 in a specific person or object; detecting a demon's true nature normally succeeds automatically (though its Magic Resistance must still be Penetrated), while a divine being actively hiding its nature raises the Ease Factor to 15. This Ability is granted by the Divine realm rather than Magic or Faerie. Specialties: good or evil.

entries.name: Sense Passions
entries.description: Senses the personality and desires of an intelligent being by reading the tarnish on its soul: a Perception + Sense Passions roll against an Ease Factor of 9 senses the target's most powerful current emotion, or 15 identifies their most dominant Personality Trait; a 12 or better also lets you pick out the strongest source of emotion in the general area. The effect must Penetrate the target's Magic Resistance if any, and can also detect nearby incorporeal spirits and sense whether an aura carries Divine or Infernal tarnish or temper, though it cannot distinguish which. Specialties: auras, emotions, Personality Traits, in a general area.

entries.name: Shapeshifter
entries.description: Lets you change your shape into that of a mundane animal, from the size of a robin to that of a bear; requires a round of concentration and a Stamina + Shapeshifter roll against an Ease Factor of 9, both to change and to change back. You have a limited repertoire of shapes, one per point of the Ability, and may choose a new one each time it increases. Specialties: one of your shapes, particular conditions for the change.

entries.name: Summon Animals
entries.description: Summons animals; described in the Hermetic Magic chapter.

entries.name: Whistle Up The Wind
entries.description: Creates wind by whistling; described in the Hermetic Magic chapter.

entries.name: Wilderness Sense
entries.description: A mystical attunement to the ways of the wilderness: a Perception + Wilderness Sense roll against an Ease Factor of 9 reveals the direction of north, the upcoming weather, or the presence of natural hazards or resources -- one roll reveals only one piece of information. Specialties: direction, weather, hazards, resources.

entries.name: Adjuration
entries.description: A Holy Power: commanding, binding and banishing spirits and other supernatural beings in God's name, as in exorcism. Holy Powers are worked through a Holy Method (and a Method through a Power), as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form.

entries.name: Blessing
entries.description: A Holy Power: invoking the protective and inspirational side of the Divine on people and things. Holy Powers are worked through a Holy Method (and a Method through a Power), as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form.

entries.name: Holy Music
entries.description: A Holy Method, like Meditation: devotional song or chant (Presence + Music) that brings divine insight; taught chiefly by the Cantores. Holy Powers are worked through a Holy Method (and a Method through a Power), as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form.

entries.name: Kabbalah
entries.description: A Holy Method of Jewish mysticism, used in place of Invocation: contemplating the divine names and the Sefirot. Also allows constructing golems. Holy Powers are worked through a Holy Method (and a Method through a Power), as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form.

entries.name: Merkavah
entries.description: A Holy Method of Jewish chariot mysticism, used in place of Purity: ascending through fasting and prayer to study the angelic and demonic orders and learn True Names. Holy Powers are worked through a Holy Method (and a Method through a Power), as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form.

entries.name: Mechanica of Heron
entries.description: Designing, building and empowering magical mechanical devices, automata among them, in the tradition of Heron of Alexandria.

entries.name: Mythic Herbalism
entries.description: Brewing concoctions from plants and other ingredients that heal, poison or grant physical benefits; taught by the Pharmacopoeians.

entries.name: Storm Calling
entries.description: A storm wizard's power to raise a fresh storm around himself or steer one already blowing (Communication + Storm Calling). Raising one spends Auram vis by its extent (1 pawn local, 2 provincial, 4 national) against an Ease Factor built from extent plus how long it lasts; steering costs no vis and depends on extent alone. Once raised the weather is wholly natural and needs no Penetration. Specialties: storm creation, storm moving.

entries.name: Storm Fighting
entries.description: A storm wizard's power to turn a storm he can see on people and buildings caught inside it: buffeting gusts (several a round, +10 damage, never through Magic Resistance), a soaking deluge that knocks people off their feet, hail (+3), erosion that brings a building down, or a lightning bolt (+20, which must Penetrate). Specialties: specific attack targets (giants), specific attack types.

entries.name: Storm Riding
entries.description: A storm wizard's power over any place a visible storm covers (Perception + Storm Riding, +3 from within it): Ease Factor 9 to watch from a chosen point while concentrating, 12 to step there at once, 15 to send someone he touches (whose Magic Resistance it must Penetrate). Specialties: seeing, traveling (self), traveling (others).

entries.name: Elementalist Air
entries.description: A Hedge Art of the learned elementalists: one of their four elemental Forms, Air, worked with their Techniques (Controlling, Divining, Refining, Summoning). Advances like an Ability.

entries.name: Elementalist Earth
entries.description: A Hedge Art of the learned elementalists: one of their four elemental Forms, Earth, worked with their Techniques (Controlling, Divining, Refining, Summoning). Advances like an Ability.

entries.name: Elementalist Fire
entries.description: A Hedge Art of the learned elementalists: one of their four elemental Forms, Fire, worked with their Techniques (Controlling, Divining, Refining, Summoning). Advances like an Ability.

entries.name: Elementalist Water
entries.description: A Hedge Art of the learned elementalists: one of their four elemental Forms, Water, worked with their Techniques (Controlling, Divining, Refining, Summoning). Advances like an Ability.

entries.name: Theology: Pagan
entries.description: The pagan philosophers' teaching on the divine and first causes, as in Aristotle's Metaphysics. Art & Academe names it only as the subject of books.

entries.name: Herbalism
entries.description: Folk remedies and natural magic, open only through the Herbalism Virtue (A&A p. 55): it stands in for Medicine when diagnosing a disease, judging its course and helping a patient recover, and lets the herbalist make theriacs and medical ligatures. It is not Medicine: books on Medicine teach it nothing, and it cannot set a regimen for good health. Specialties: diagnosis, prognosis, therapy, theriacs, a specific disease.

entries.name: Elementalist Summoning
entries.description: A Technique of the learned elementalists: he calls an element, its creatures or its elementals to him. Its type (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical) comes from the Virtue that grants it, and every type he has shares this one score. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Elementalist Controlling
entries.description: A Technique of the learned elementalists: he commands an element, its creatures or its elementals. Its type (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical) comes from the Virtue that grants it, and every type he has shares this one score. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Elementalist Divining
entries.description: A Technique of the learned elementalists: he learns about an element, its creatures or its humour. Its type (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical) comes from the Virtue that grants it, and every type he has shares this one score. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Elementalist Refining
entries.description: A Technique of the learned elementalists: he works an element in a season of laboratory work, making potions and vis. Its type (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical) comes from the Virtue that grants it, and every type he has shares this one score. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Folk Witch Magic Theory
entries.description: The folk witches' theory of magic: added to every kitchen Lab Total, it sets how many doses a potion makes and how much vis she can use in a season. An Arcane Ability anyone can be taught. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Cursing
entries.description: A folk witch's power to curse through a fetish worked with an Arcane Connection, or through a potion (Dexterity + Cursing): disease, miscarriage, aging, emotion, loss of tongue, paralysis, beast form or shrinking. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Flight
entries.description: A folk witch's power to fly at the speed of a galloping horse for up to her score in hours, through a fetish (such as a broom) or a potion (Stamina + Flight). Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Healing
entries.description: A folk witch's true healing of wounds and Fatigue by incantation or potion (Stamina + Healing); it needs Corpus vis and must penetrate. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Animal Healing
entries.description: Healing as the folk witches work it, but on animals and using Animal vis; it can be brewed into potions. Granted by the Animal Healer Virtue. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Gruagach Give
entries.description: The gruagach Technique that bestows: blessings, curses, new shapes and visions given to a target. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Gruagach Take
entries.description: The gruagach Technique that removes: taking away blessings, lifting curses, restoring true shape and seeing through or dispelling visions. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Gruagach Blessing
entries.description: The gruagach Form of good fortune: granting or removing bonuses to Abilities and Characteristics and minor Virtues. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Gruagach Curse
entries.description: The gruagach Form of curses and geasa: penalties, Flaws, disease and crippling, and their removal. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Gruagach Shape
entries.description: The gruagach Form of transformation: animal features, changes of size, and turning people into beasts, plants or objects. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Gruagach Vision
entries.description: The gruagach Form of sight and sound: illusions, sensing at a distance, visions and premonitions. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Pictish
entries.description: The gruagachan's theory of magic, used in place of Magic Theory to invent spells, make tattoos and resist Warping; it also caps their Arts (5 at Pictish 1, 15 at 2, 30 at 3, no limit from 4). Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Jotnar
entries.description: The trollsynir's theory of magic, used in place of Pictish by this Norse branch of the gruagachan. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Koldovali Theory
entries.description: The kolduni's theory of magic, used in place of Pictish by this Slavic branch of the gruagachan. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Tueor
entries.description: The learned magicians' Technique of protection, used in charms, amulets and chartae; akin to Rego. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Succurro
entries.description: The learned magicians' Technique of aid, improving its target without permanent healing; akin to Creo. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Vulnero
entries.description: The learned magicians' Technique of harm; akin to Perdo. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Fortunam
entries.description: The learned magicians' Form of luck, affecting Ability rolls, botches and fortune. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Magicam
entries.description: The learned magicians' Form of magic itself, affecting charms, amulets, vis and supernatural powers; akin to Vim. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Salutem
entries.description: The learned magicians' Form of the health of any living thing: protection from harm, recovery, aging and injury. Advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Mythic Alchemy
entries.description: Alchemy that truly transmutes matter: added to the alchemist's Lab Total for reagents, and used in place of Magic Theory for his vis limits. Granted by the Mythic Alchemy Virtue. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Fehu
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of wealth: bonuses to rolls that gain wealth, detecting precious metal and domestic animals, summoning wealth. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Uruz
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of strength: Strength and Encumbrance, immunity to mind effects, summoning wild animals. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Thurisaz
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of the thorn: negative passions, reducing Might, brambles, and changing one thing into another. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ansuz
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of speech: Communication rolls, hearing through illusions, giving speech, sensing Might and reading thoughts. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Raido
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of the journey: travel, Stamina, Initiative, sensing direction, faster travel and summoning large objects. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Kauno
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of fire and sickness: disease rolls and recovery, igniting and heating, sores and illness. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Gebo
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of the gift: influencing others, from deference up to total domination. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Wunjo
entries.description: A rune of Freya's aett, the rune of joy: Presence rolls, easing Fatigue and wound penalties, powerful emotion. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Hagalaz
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of hail: damage, hailstones, storms and changes of weather. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Naudiz
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of need: great need and retried rolls, delaying or binding other magic, Confidence. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Isa
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of ice: cold, freezing and melting, chill damage, apathy and holding a target still. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Jera
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of the year: year-long activities, immunity to disease, health and blight, summoning food and drink. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ihwaz
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of the yew: Intelligence, sensing and summoning beings with Might, plants, corpses and the dead. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Perth
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of chance: pure-chance rolls and botch dice, dispelling, sensing auras, vis and active magic. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Algiz
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of protection: Soak, and warding off supernatural beings of a secondary rune's type. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Sowilo
entries.description: A rune of Heimdall's aett, the rune of the sun: Perception, seeing through illusions, darkvision, sensing Divine and Infernal auras, light. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Tiwaz
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of Tyr: positive emotions, Attack and Defense, Confidence, sensing people, motives and lies. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Berkanan
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of the birch: recovery from injury, fertility, and healing or preventing the healing of wounds. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ehwaz
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of the horse: mounted rolls, Quickness, trust between two people, taming and summoning a mount. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Mannaz
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of mankind: Dexterity and group work, cooperation. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Laguz
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of water: rolls in or on water, summoning and sensing water, breathing water, sea speed and waves. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ingwaz
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of family and home: rolls about family, sensing family, easy birth, summoning a person. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dagaz
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of the day: day-long activities, aging, and growth or maturity. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Othila
entries.description: A rune of Tyr's aett, the rune of the heirloom: rolls with a specific tool, exceptional quality, summoning small objects. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Rune Magic
entries.description: The vitkir's theory of rune magic: added to the Vitkar Lab Total for inventing and learning rune scripts, and used to decipher another's hidden runes. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Evocation
entries.description: A Faerie Method (Communication): rites worked by calling on faerie powers with a bold voice and gestures, for a Warping Point or a Confidence Point a use. It lets vis (+2 a pawn, up to Evocation + the Power) feed any rite. Pairs with any Faerie Power; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Enchantment
entries.description: A Faerie Method (Presence): rites hidden in a performance. A performance roll against 3 x the intended magnitude must succeed first, and may be repeated to build a larger effect. Pairs with any Faerie Power; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Empathy
entries.description: A Faerie Method (Stamina): rites worked in an hour's trance for a Fatigue level, which returns only when the effect ends; spending more Fatigue lengthens the rite and raises its Sympathy limit. Pairs with any Faerie Power; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Beguile
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites that change a target's memories, emotions or perceptions, up to commands and total control. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Conjure
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites that conjure faeries and glamours, or turn a target into a glamour of another shape. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Dream
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites of foresight, giving a target Premonitions or answering questions about the future, from the next minute to the next century. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Grant
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites that give a target Might, faerie powers, temporary Sympathy Traits, Warping, Virtues or Flaws, or a temporary Faerie aura or regio. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Portage
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites of travel, carrying a target into or out of regiones and the Faerie Realm, teleporting it, or speeding its movement. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Ware
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites of protection, suppressing supernatural effects, warding against beings and things, and adding to Soak or Defense. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Weal
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites of healing and vitality, curing wounds for a time, speeding recovery, trading Aging against Recovery, and making a target look younger. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Woe
entries.description: A Faerie Power: rites of harm, draining Fatigue, inflicting wounds that vanish when the rite ends, slowing healing, and forcing Recovery or Aging rolls. Worked through a Faerie Method; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: (Faerie) Summoning
entries.description: One of the Ars Fabulosa (Presence): for a Fatigue level, calls a faerie whose Might is within 5 x the summoner's Sympathy Traits, holding it to listen if the total beats its Might. Starts at 0 and advances on the Art table, though practised and studied as a Supernatural Ability.

entries.name: Bonding
entries.description: One of the Ars Fabulosa (Communication): binds a faerie to the bargainer or an object, sharing its senses, powers or a stored spell, or shielding him from deprivation, Aging and Faerie Warping for a season. Starts at 0 and advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Captivating
entries.description: One of the Ars Fabulosa (Perception): swaps bodies with a faerie whose Might the total exceeds; his own body slowly Warps while the faerie wears it. Starts at 0 and advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dismissing
entries.description: One of the Ars Fabulosa (Intelligence): cancels or deflects the powers of beings with Might and frees them from agreements, including the bargainer's own. Starts at 0 and advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ceremony
entries.description: Leading a group ritual: each participant adds his Characteristic and score in the Ability used, and the focus adds the sum of everyone's Ceremony less the number taking part. In Faerie use every participant performs the rite's Method.

entries.name: Invocation
entries.description: A Holy Method: a prayer cried aloud or written down, adding Communication + Invocation to the effect total for a Confidence (or Faith) Point; the caster may roll a stress die instead of a simple one. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Meditation
entries.description: A Holy Method: an hour of chanting or focused contemplation, with a Stamina roll against 6 every ten minutes (a Fatigue level on a failure), adding Intelligence + Meditation to the effect total. It also bears on Divine Ascent rolls. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Purity
entries.description: A Holy Method: an exertion costly enough to take a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound, adding Stamina + Purity to the effect total. Lets any Method's ritual be repeated to spend more Confidence before the roll. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Intervention
entries.description: A Holy Power: makes the Divine visibly manifest in the world, and can reveal supernatural effects; worked through Meditation or Purity. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Transcendence
entries.description: A Holy Power: lifts the holy person's own mind and body past earthly limits, warding off lesser powers or hardening the flesh; worked through Meditation or Purity. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Understanding
entries.description: A Holy Power: holy visions that bring guidance and knowledge, or lessen the risk of a botch; worked through Meditation. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Wonders
entries.description: A Holy Power: calls creatures, objects and forces of nature into being by God's power; worked through Invocation. Holy Methods and Powers pair as Hermetic magic pairs a Technique with a Form; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Craft Amulets
entries.description: The Ba'al Shem's craft of protective amulets (Touch, worn): a minor amulet in a few hours with Dexterity + Craft Amulets, a major one over seasons that also adds a Holy Method and Power. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Gematria
entries.description: The Jewish form of the Meditation Method: hours of study of a text, after which the lower of Gematria and the book's Quality stands in for Meditation. Also used to change one's True Name and lengthen life. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Dream Interpretation
entries.description: A form of Meditation through dreams: an hour's prayer, a night's sleep and a few hours' contemplation before the effect is rolled. Also a divination of its own, Intelligence + Dream Interpretation against the level of a matching Intellego effect. Advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Holy Magic
entries.description: Hermetic magic re-aligned to the Divine: replaces Magic Theory in the magus's lab work and spell design, lets him draw on Divine auras, and lets prayer or a Holy Method stand in for words and gestures. Supernatural and Arcane; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Ars Notoria
entries.description: The Notory Art: reciting the seven Rings of Solomon, Intelligence + Ars Notoria against an Ease Factor set by the ring, for temporary learning, Characteristic boosts, an angelic teacher, divination and freedom from botches. First learned only from its own text by a Gifted Christian. Academic, Arcane and Supernatural; advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Debauchery
entries.description: An Unholy Method of the maleficia: the infernalist works her will through a strenuous sinful act, paying a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound per casting. Pairs with an Unholy Power and adds Stamina; a season-long rite adds Infernal Lore and needs no die. Granted by the Debauchery Virtue. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Incantation
entries.description: An Unholy Method of the maleficia: spoken blasphemous rites that cost a Confidence Point, or a Warping Point for a sin committed during the rite. Pairs with an Unholy Power and adds Communication; may be boosted with vis (+2 a pawn) and lets her recognise vis. Granted by the Incantation Virtue. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Consumption
entries.description: An Unholy Power of the maleficia: drains the strength, health or youth of one living victim to feed another target. Worked through Debauchery or Incantation. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Diablerie
entries.description: An Unholy Power of the maleficia over spirits, demons and Infernal places: sees through creatures' eyes, compels and binds them, taints vis, raises Infernal auras and dispels supernatural effects. Never touches the Divine. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Effusion
entries.description: An Unholy Power of the maleficia over the lifeless world: heats, chills, softens, hardens and hurls objects, rouses storms and fire, and carries things great distances. Cannot create or touch living things. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Malediction
entries.description: An Unholy Power of the maleficia that curses: wounds, wasting disease, penalties and extra botch dice, cursed objects, lost Virtues and imposed Flaws. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Phantasm
entries.description: An Unholy Power of the maleficia that makes illusions, disguises and distant senses, and ominous visions. Its phantasms vanish at any Divine touch or the caster's chosen weakness and cannot exist in the Dominion. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Psychomachia
entries.description: An Unholy Power of the maleficia over the soul: shifts emotions and Personality Traits, plants thoughts, gives Warping or Confidence, tarnishes auras and at its height controls a person outright. A Supernatural Ability: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Summoning
entries.description: The primary Goetic Art: calls an incorporeal spirit into a circle (or, by Scouring, whatever spirit answers) for bargaining or for the other Goetic Arts. Presence + Summoning + the target's Realm Lore + aura + Penetration; costs a Fatigue level. Opened at 0 by its Virtue. An Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ablating
entries.description: A Goetic Art that strips Might from a spirit for the sorcerer's own gain: Confidence, Characteristics, healing, knowledge, powers or vis, at a Warping Point each time. Stamina + Ablating + Realm Lore + aura + Penetration. Opened at 0 by its Virtue. An Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Binding
entries.description: A Goetic Art that seals a spirit into an object or a person, giving the bearer Magic Resistance and access to its powers and knowledge. Intelligence + Binding + Realm Lore + aura + Penetration. Opened at 0 by its Virtue. An Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Commanding
entries.description: A Goetic Art that orders a spirit to serve until the next midday or midnight: follow, aid, protect, glorify, teach or heal its master. Communication + Commanding + Realm Lore + aura + Penetration. Opened at 0 by its Virtue. An Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Corruption
entries.description: Subverts an audience without its knowing: spending a Confidence Point stirs a Personality Trait in listeners, her writings pass on sinful Traits, and what she teaches gives Corrupted Abilities or Corrupted Arts. Com + Corruption + die, resisted by Per + Infernal Lore. Granted by the Corruption Virtue.

entries.name: Chthonic Magic
entries.description: Only magi may learn it. Lets a magus draw on the Infernal in sinister magic: it can replace Magic Theory for dark lab work and adds to how much Infernal vis he may use. Granted by the Chthonic Magic Virtue.

entries.name: Control Fertility
entries.description: Strengthens or withdraws the life force in people, beasts and plants: fertile fields or blight, milk or a dry cow, conception or barrenness. Rolled with Presence for a month or more; higher scores unlock stronger effects. The Scinnfolk call it Fertility.

entries.name: Warding
entries.description: Draws a circle that keeps out one chosen kind of thing, natural or supernatural, rolled with Stamina. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Banishing
entries.description: A loud command that drives every creature of a named realm out of the area for a day, rolled with Presence. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Comprehend Magic
entries.description: Senses and analyses magic of any kind: whether it is there, then its type, function and strength, rolled with Perception. Includes all that Magic Sensitivity does.

entries.name: Sihr
entries.description: The sahir's art of summoning jinn and lending power to the bargain that binds them to service, rolled with Presence against the jinni's Might. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Solomonic Alchemy
entries.description: One of the five Solomonic arts of the sahirs: spells (naranjs) and lab work cast through a spirit the sahir has summoned. Works on non-living matter the sahir touches, changing its size and nature, and moves, draws or removes vis in the laboratory. Its associated Ability is Philosophiae. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Solomonic Astrology
entries.description: One of the five Solomonic arts of the sahirs: spells (naranjs) and lab work cast through a spirit the sahir has summoned. Learns about a target he can see or has an Arcane Connection to, past, present or future; also invents summoning spells and fixes Arcane Connections. Its associated Ability is Artes Liberales (a horoscope). An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Solomonic Physic
entries.description: One of the five Solomonic arts of the sahirs: spells (naranjs) and lab work cast through a spirit the sahir has summoned. Heals or harms a body by touch, wounds, diseases and traits alike, and powers the elixir Al-Iksir. Its associated Ability is Medicine. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Solomonic Storytelling
entries.description: One of the five Solomonic arts of the sahirs: spells (naranjs) and lab work cast through a spirit the sahir has summoned. Sways an audience within earshot through a tale, and seeks out or scours spirits from an area in the laboratory. Its associated Ability is Area Lore. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Solomonic Travel
entries.description: One of the five Solomonic arts of the sahirs: spells (naranjs) and lab work cast through a spirit the sahir has summoned. Opens passages and windows through a marked target or circle, wards against spirits, and Opens a student to the Solomonic arts. Its associated Ability is the (Realm) Lore of the effect's realm. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Soban Alchemy
entries.description: The alchemists of Soba spend a dose of their Sovereign Reagent to give or take away one property of lifeless, non-magical matter (colour, hardness, heat...), rolled with Intelligence against an Ease Factor set by the property. The score sets how long it lasts.

entries.name: Disjunction
entries.description: A settut power, worked through a single-use amulet whose Potency plus a die is rolled against the power's Ease Factor (plus a Duration modifier). Strips a target of The Gift and every Supernatural Virtue for the Duration, penetrating as Vim. Taught to Berber settuten. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dislocation
entries.description: A settut power, worked through a single-use amulet whose Potency plus a die is rolled against the power's Ease Factor (plus a Duration modifier). Shortens a journey on foot or mount to a destination she can see or name, up to a hundredth of its time. Taught to Tuareg settuten. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dismay
entries.description: A settut power, worked through a single-use amulet whose Potency plus a die is rolled against the power's Ease Factor (plus a Duration modifier). A withering insult that blocks a group of related Abilities, from no Confidence up to no use at all, penetrating as Mentem. Taught to Tuareg settuten. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dismissal
entries.description: A settut power, worked through a single-use amulet whose Potency plus a die is rolled against the power's Ease Factor (plus a Duration modifier). Drives every creature of one named realm out of an area, up to a Boundary, and hinders its return. Taught to both branches. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dissidence
entries.description: A settut power, worked through a single-use amulet whose Potency plus a die is rolled against the power's Ease Factor (plus a Duration modifier). Turns one person against another, from dislike to murderous loathing, penetrating as Mentem. Taught to Berber settuten. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Dissolution
entries.description: A settut power, worked through a single-use amulet whose Potency plus a die is rolled against the power's Ease Factor (plus a Duration modifier). Weakens or destroys lifeless matter, from cloth to stone and magical objects, and dries up springs. Taught to both branches. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Settut Divination
entries.description: The seeress's (tineqiqqit's) divination: answers one question as a non-Ritual Hermetic Intellego spell of Momentary Duration, by one of the methods she knows (one per point). Rolled with Perception in a round, or Intelligence in a ceremony of 15 minutes a magnitude, against the spell's level. Only a seeress may lead settuten or Open The Gift. An Accelerated Ability: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Geomancy
entries.description: Reads patterns drawn in sand or dust for about an hour to learn of an event touching a person, now or in the last half-day, through an Arcane or sympathetic connection. Each try costs a Confidence Point (with no bonus). Rolled with Perception plus a stylus bonus against 9 to 15 by how important the event is, plus the answer's complexity. The answer is always allegorical.

entries.name: Ecstatic Magic
entries.description: The sorginak power of leaving the body as an intangible spirit during an akelarre (Sta + Ecstatic Magic vs 12 for an hour, more for a higher total), seeing spirits while out. Granted by the Ecstatic Magic Virtue.

entries.name: Emotion Theft
entries.description: Takes an emotion from someone showing it (Pre + Emotion Theft vs 6 + their Trait) and gives it by touch to another. Granted by Thief of Emotions.

entries.name: Hermetic Viresculture
entries.description: Breeding self-reproducing vis from magical creatures and plants: Vitalization makes a Stirps in the lab, Invigoration lets it breed, and the magus tends at most his score in Stirpes. Usable only by those Opened to the Hermetic Arts, and taught without the Art-score penalty.

entries.name: Saint's Aid
entries.description: Calling on a patron saint to ignore the Fatigue or Confidence cost of Divine powers, Methods or Holy Magic, up to this score in times between confessions. Granted by Saint's Aid.

entries.name: Set the Stones of the Via
entries.description: A Greater non-Hermetic Mercurian ritual (EF 36; 36 pawns and 36 Mythic pounds of materials; a season) that binds milestones and lapides mercurii into a via mercuria. Its text gives +6 to Insight for True Mercurian Road Magic.

entries.name: Link the Rent Path
entries.description: A Lesser non-Hermetic Mercurian ritual (EF 18; 18 pawns and 18 Mythic pounds; 3 hours) that joins viae mercuriae, adds a lapis or replaces a lost milestone. Its text gives +3 to Insight for True Mercurian Road Magic.

entries.name: Alala
entries.description: An Amazon Vowel (a Technique): to open: summoning, wounding, opening earth or sky, making light. Paired with a Consonant to sing incantations and rites. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Ma'at
entries.description: An Amazon Vowel (a Technique): to measure: knowing, and commanding what is known (by sight only). Paired with a Consonant to sing incantations and rites. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Papaios
entries.description: An Amazon Vowel (a Technique): to close: healing, banishing, ending, lengthening life. Paired with a Consonant to sing incantations and rites. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Api
entries.description: An Amazon Consonant (a Form): earth and daylight, earth elementals and melancholic animals. Each Consonant has its own base Range and Duration. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Kardia
entries.description: An Amazon Consonant (a Form): the humors: personality, symptoms of disease and Fatigue. Each Consonant has its own base Range and Duration. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Nux
entries.description: An Amazon Consonant (a Form): sky, weather and night, air elementals and birds (sanguine animals). Each Consonant has its own base Range and Duration. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Soma
entries.description: An Amazon Consonant (a Form): the human body and other human-shaped beings of flesh and bone. Each Consonant has its own base Range and Duration. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Zoi
entries.description: An Amazon Consonant (a Form): incorporeal spirits with Might, and The Gift. Each Consonant has its own base Range and Duration. A normal Art: advances on the Art table.

entries.name: Amazonian Chant
entries.description: The unwritten dead language every Amazon spell is sung in. It multiplies a spell's Duration and makes it harder to resist; no Art or magical Arcane Ability can rise until it is at least 1. Specialty: a Vowel.

entries.name: Amazonian Spellcraft
entries.description: The Amazon sorceress's theory of magic: added to her Temple Total and needed to learn or invent spells and to set up a temple (at 3), though not to cast. Specialties: learning spells, enchanted items, one Art.

entries.name: Amazonian Cult Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of the sorceresses' rites, for sorceresses only. The sum of the participants' scores must reach a rite's magnitude, and it is the Initiation lore. Specialty: a Vowel.

entries.name: Amazonia Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of Amazonia, its people, customs and places; every Amazon may learn it.

entries.name: School of Boreas
entries.description: A Vigilo School of the Augustan Brotherhood, the counterpart of Auram: weather. Its score is roughly one Hermetic magnitude, and its rites ward a place until a trigger. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table; can be practised but not raised in the lab.

entries.name: School of the Naiads
entries.description: A Vigilo School of the Augustan Brotherhood, the counterpart of Aquam: liquids. Its score is roughly one Hermetic magnitude, and its rites ward a place until a trigger. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table; can be practised but not raised in the lab.

entries.name: School of Prometheus
entries.description: A Vigilo School of the Augustan Brotherhood, the counterpart of Ignem: fire and light. Its score is roughly one Hermetic magnitude, and its rites ward a place until a trigger. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table; can be practised but not raised in the lab.

entries.name: School of the Stones
entries.description: A Vigilo School of the Augustan Brotherhood, the counterpart of Terram: earth, stone and metal. Its score is roughly one Hermetic magnitude, and its rites ward a place until a trigger. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table; can be practised but not raised in the lab.

entries.name: School of the Sylvan Dryads
entries.description: A Vigilo School of the Augustan Brotherhood, the counterpart of Herbam: plants. Its score is roughly one Hermetic magnitude, and its rites ward a place until a trigger. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table; can be practised but not raised in the lab.

entries.name: School of the Vigilant Bees
entries.description: A Vigilo School of the Augustan Brotherhood, the counterpart of Animal: beasts. Its score is roughly one Hermetic magnitude, and its rites ward a place until a trigger. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table; can be practised but not raised in the lab.

entries.name: Sortes Virgilianae
entries.description: Divination by opening the Aeneid at random: answers about the present at a distance, never about the past, the future or the wizard himself. Costs a long-term Fatigue level; the Aeneid is a summa on it (level 10, Quality 8).

entries.name: Animo
entries.description: The Virgilian art of awakening animations: crafted objects of excellent quality that become Magic creatures obeying their maker, and into which rites can be inscribed.

entries.name: Virgilian Theory
entries.description: The Augustan Brotherhood's theory of magic, in place of Magic Theory: added to rite learning, awakening and inscribing animations.

entries.name: Virgilian Rite: {rite}
entries.description: One Vigilo rite of the Augustan Brotherhood, each its own score: a narrow ward on one School's effect that waits for a trigger. A normal Art: advances on the Art table, by the lab, practice, teaching or a tractatus on that rite.

entries.name: Sjonhverfing
entries.description: Visual illusions up to the size of a hut, lasting an hour or until dismissed; a sharp-eyed viewer sees the flaws. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Spadomur
entries.description: Allegorical visions of present events through an Arcane or Sympathetic Connection, about an hour's trance, helped by a fitting reflecting surface. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Storm's Eye
entries.description: Raises fog, rain or storms around himself or a touched person or object, moving with them, until dismissed or sunrise; he is immune to it. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Threads of Fate
entries.description: Twists his own luck for a named event: favored rolls, pre-rolled dice, fewer botch dice, rerolls; baleful versions curse others. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Valgaldrar
entries.description: Necromancy on an intact, unburied corpse: makes it speak, tell the truth, or rise and obey while he is in sight. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Wildfire
entries.description: Commands an existing fire within 15 paces: spreads, intensifies or moves it; with utiseta, lava and volcanoes. Always +2 botch dice. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Winter's Breath
entries.description: Drumming brings cold to a 100-pace circle, from chill and frost to blizzards, and freezes water; magical, so it must penetrate. A Muspelli power, used ordinarily or enlarged by utiseta; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Aloe Magic
entries.description: The Aloe Tribe's restoration and healing: mends and regrows living and dead things, regrows lost parts and restores lost Virtues. Patron spirits: the bennu, herons of light. A Soqotran sorcerer's style, cast with incense and vis; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Cinnabar Magic
entries.description: The Cinnabar Tribe's preservation, defense and luck: Soak bonuses, immunities and rolls kept for a whole activity, and a longevity bonus. Patron spirits: giant red geckos. A Soqotran sorcerer's style, cast with incense and vis; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Myrrh Magic
entries.description: The Myrrh Tribe's gift of folklore heroes' traits: grants Virtues and Flaws. Patron spirits: the jinniyah, faeries of the myrrh groves. A Soqotran sorcerer's style, cast with incense and vis; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Olibanum Magic
entries.description: The Olibanum Tribe's command of objects, beasts, spirits and winds by spoken orders, from a loaf to the sea. Patron spirits: olibanum serpents. A Soqotran sorcerer's style, cast with incense and vis; on the Ability table.

entries.name: Canaanite Necromancy
entries.description: Ancient necromancy of En-Dor: duplicates any Corpus or Mentem effect that speaks with, commands or summons the dead, rolled against 3 x the effect's magnitude. A botch lets a demon impersonate the dead. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Defixio Lore
entries.description: The craft of the Roman curse-tablet cults: a day's preparation and vis make a defixio carrying one of the cult's effects, against an Ease Factor set by how well the target is known. One cult known per point. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Azai
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Beautiful Light: life, vitality, birth, light and sunshine, authority, love and spirits, gold. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Eloure
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Fire Delighter: waters and rain, blood and fertility, emotions and dreams, amber and silver. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Iaó
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Fire Feeler: pleasure and beauty, the senses, winds and sweet smells, disease, auras and sensing magic. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Óai
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Light Breather: intelligence, quick thought and eloquence. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Pentiterouni
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Firewalker: perseverance, control and earthy things, bones, flesh, skin and aging. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Psyrinpheu
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Fire Breather: passion, war, heat, wolves, muscles, stamina and youth, iron and diamond. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Hymn Semesilam
entries.description: A Hyperborean hymn to Apollo, Encloser, Lightmaker: the arts and music, health, justice and good fortune, fruit trees, swans. Each point holds 15 levels of infused Powers, adds to Soak against harm of its principles and to relevant Lab Totals. On the Ability table.

entries.name: Scry
entries.description: A Hunters' Art: forges a mystic link to a foe, from touch, sight or an Arcane Connection, that tells its direction and distance or lets the hunter share its senses (Perception + Scry + Foe). Works only with a Foe Art. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Ban
entries.description: A Hunters' Art: makes amulets that soak a foe's wounds or blunt its powers, and rings of hawthorn stakes that drain its Might. Works only with a Foe Art. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Slay
entries.description: A Hunters' Art: charges a new weapon over a day so that one penetrating hit leaves the foe Incapacitated; facts known about the foe make it easier. Works only with a Foe Art. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Foe: {foe}
entries.description: A Hunters' Art naming one kind of supernatural foe (Vampire, Werewolf, Ghost, Nightwalker, Witch, Dragon...), paired with Scry, Ban or Slay as a Form is with a Technique. A Difficult Art: advances on the Ability table.

entries.name: Fertility Lore
entries.description: Knowledge of the ancient fertility cults' magic, from a Minor integration breakthrough: a few minutes' look tells how fertile a person, beast or field is, and it supervises the Fertility Ritual. Advances on the Ability table.
